construction: <1-4 focused object tokens> ayuu/ayay <reviewed noun subject> <exact reviewed finite verb>
source_evidence: project native review — Jigjiga Somali: Muus ayuu wiilku cunay.
reviewed focus contractions: ayuu = ayaa + uu; ayay = ayaa + ay
exact reviewed CUN finite paradigm — Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012), p. 921
subject_control: The explicit noun immediately after ayuu/ayay controls both the contraction and finite-verb agreement.
role_safety: The sentence-initial focused object is not treated as the subject. Other finite lemmas remain unjudged until this object-first focus order is independently supported for them.
note: Review-only. Do not infer grammatical role from initial position, do not derive unseen verb forms, and do not automatically rewrite clitics or verbs.
